scripts.tauri:dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,TAURI -c cyan,yellow "npm run backend" "npm run tauri dev"
scripts.tauri:build: npm run build && npx tauri build --bundles app
scripts.make:dmg: APP="src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/TURRRBO.app" && DMG="src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/TURRRBO_0.1.0.dmg" && mkdir -p src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg && STAGING=$(mktemp -d) && cp -r "$APP" "$STAGING/TURRRBO.app" && ln -s /Applications "$STAGING/Applications" && hdiutil create -volname TURRRBO -srcfolder "$STAGING" -ov -format UDZO "$DMG" && rm -rf "$STAGING" && echo "Built: $DMG"
